messages:
alex (eng-security): flagging an unusual upstream change: runc/seccomp interaction now exposes an expanded ioctl surface when seccomp is permissive. want a coordinated base-image rebuild + ephemeral keystream rotation for cosign. also audit backfill for builder-role widening last Friday.

yuri (eng-runtime): ugh. can we do automated rebuild -> attest -> staging canary? need runtime fallback if seccomp hits.

mona (eng-infra): infra can run nightly window 03:30 UTC. plan: rebuild pipeline writes SBOM + provenance header to GCS, cosign with ephemeral keystream (KMS-wrapped), push to staging. will add registry revoke flag endpoint.

phil (sec): agree with ephemeral keystream. i'll create a short-lived CMEK wrap key and give unwrap to the pipeline via workload-identity for the window. avoid re-granting long-lived signer roles.

alex (eng-security): good. add pipeline audit events: build:start, sbom:emit, image:push, key:wrap, key:unwrap, image:sign. JSON example: {"actor":"svc:build","event":"image:sign","image":"registry.stg/base:ks-2026-03","signer":"kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ephemeral/cryptoKeys/kswrap","ts":"..."}. phil, can sec ingest that easily?

phil (sec): yes. also include field "provenance_hdr" with build-id and sbom-sha so we can tie GCS objects to audit events. add "rbac_patch" if any IAM grants happen.

ci-bot: CI queued: rbld-31876-stg initiator=alex. link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/rbld-31876-stg

yuri (eng-runtime): runtime checklist for patched image:
- Dockerfile: set no_new_privs=1 and apply minimal seccomp strict profile
- entrypoint: drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_RAWIO
- containerd: enforce userns remap for non-privileged images by default
- include attest sidecar that waits for SBOM verification before readiness

mona (eng-infra): infra tasks:
- create maintenance window and freeze builders for 6m at cut
- generate ephemeral keystream: kms encrypt -> unwrap in pipeline via workload-identity for 15m TTL
- cosign using keystream: cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/.../kswrap
- write audit JSONL to gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-31876-stg/audit.jsonl
- expose POST /registry/v1/revoke {"image":"..."}

alex (eng-security): for audit backfill, query example phil can run:
```
logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"build-service@redwood"
(protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "projects.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy" OR "google.iam.admin.v1.BindRole"))
timestamp>="2026-03-26T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<"2026-03-28T00:00:00Z"
```
correlate with gs://redwood-build-logs/*/rbld-* and KMS access logs for keyRing 'ephemeral'.

phil (sec): running the backfill after staging push completes. will share CSV. if we detect any sign events using the old long-lived signer in that window, we trigger revoke+rbld-resign immediately.

ci-bot: job rbld-31876-stg started: runner=builder-9 image=debian-14+runc-seccomp-fix

yuri (eng-runtime): post-build staging smoke command:
```
kubectl run seccomp-canary --rm -i --image=registry.stg/base:seccomp-patch --restart=Never --overrides='{"spec":{"containers":[{"securityContext":{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false}}]}}'
kubectl logs seccomp-canary
```
starting runtime-fuzzer 25m; auto-rollback on kernel oops or >2 policy-deny spikes in 5m.

mona (eng-infra): cosign sign done, GCS audit JSONL written, artifact pushed to registry with tag staging+sha. artifacts at gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-31876-stg/.

phil (sec): kicking audit backfill now. querying cloudaudit + kms logs. will paste CSV to ticket in ~8m.

yuri (eng-runtime): canary is up. added eBPF probes for seccomp trap counters and ptrace. will escalate to auto-rollback on >5 traps/min. fallback: route traffic to runc-legacy pool and pause rollout.

ci-bot: job rbld-31876-stg completed: status=SUCCESS duration=13m artifacts: gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-31876-stg/ - triggered by alex

phil (sec): audited results: no unexpected sign/unwarp events during the backfill window. KMS key usage shows unwraps only by ephemeral workload-identity principal. CSV attached to ticket.

alex (eng-security): great. runtime, monitor for 30m at 1% canary then move to 10% if stable. infra, enable registry staging-only flag until 10% stable. owners: mona=infra & revoke/resign, yuri=runtime & canary fallback, phil=KMS + audit correlation, alex=sec lead + incident runbook.

mona (eng-infra): registry staging-only flag set. quick-revoke endpoint ready if needed. rbld-resign job template available: rbld-resign-ephemeral -> reads artifacts from GCS and re-signs with new ephemeral keystream.

yuri (eng-runtime): first 10m of canary looks clean. no seccomp trap spikes. moving to 10% in 20m if still good.

phil (sec): closing audit loop: uploaded CSV and the KMS unwrap trace. adding a runbook snippet: "never grant long-lived signer perms; use ephemeral keystream via workload-identity".

alex (eng-security): closing coordination thread for this rebuild. will update runbook with the exact queries and rbld-resign play. thanks all :lock:"
